summary: Reduced fire and rescue cover at EGUL, with two vehicles carrying 6,000 gallons of extinguishing agent available.
text:
RFFS CAPABILITY DOWNGRADED TO 2 VEHICLES WITH 6000 GALLONS AGENT 
AVAILABLE. CRITICAL LEVEL OF SERVICE FOR CAT 10 AND 9 AIRCRAFTS, 
REDUCED LEVEL OF SERVICE FOR CAT 8 AIRCRAFTS.
